author_canon.statement: RRR is a post-apocalyptic nuclear-wasteland hobby and racing world.
Rad roaches assimilate parts from other insects; the biological premise is fictional.
The founding rivalry escalates from beetle horn to mantis pincers to grasshopper jumping legs, with the jumper winning the race.
The mature circuit setting is thirty years after the founding-rivalry era.
Locals lead to Regionals, then Factionals, then faction representation in New World City for the What’s Left of the World Derby.
Open is the most famous competitive class and embraces no-holds-barred builds; entry to the world championship still requires qualification.
The All-Out Offensive circuit requires a minimum offensive build and light carapace.
Speedsters prohibit weapon modules, while native violence and contact can occur.
The world mirrors PCR’s build-and-race hobby, with its own execution and identity in the sense of Mutant League’s relationship to conventional sport.
Speed, race victories, desirable upgrades, collecting, personal assembly and showing off are legitimate central pleasures.
A Wrangloid is a successful insect-catching and breeding hobbyist who turns that success into a livelihood.
Wrangloid shops resemble fish stores, with whole living insects varying in rarity, quality and price.
Anyone may search for, catch and breed insects. Expertise and discovery matter; this is not a profession-exclusive permission.
RRR is a large sandbox with accessible participation and optional depth for advanced users.
Racing remains racing; the user did not specify last-roach-standing races.
Foundational development proceeds in revisable waves using rigorous distinct statements, not story exposition.
Targeted wildland collection, selective breeding, tanks, selling unwanted stock and earned recurring livelihoods are central connected gameplay systems.
Mewgenics is a benchmark for successful consequential breeding/progression design, not permission to invent its exact mechanics.

working_proposals.statement: A native host is functional before modification; whole assemblies can satisfy several racing functions.
Installed grafts are not automatically copied into offspring.
Physical extraction updates the donor’s anatomy; vital-organ preparation consumes the donor.
The racing hobby uses portable creatures, transport cases and bench assembly; exact scale is unset.
Switchyard hoppers, Kilnback scarabs, Saltglass mantises, Gutterbred hosts and named starter kits are candidate world content.

reference_facts.translation_insight: Model breeder, retailer and venue roles independently; some businesses combine them.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya offers local-event resources including circuit loans, layouts, organizer instructions and event publicity.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Traveling course stock and local hosts can extend the hobby beyond permanent arenas.

reference_facts.statement: The rules specify starts, inspection, finish classification, disqualification and objection procedures; deliberate damage and obstruction are prohibited.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Translate race administration while deliberately changing the contact rules for RRR.

reference_facts.statement: Japan Cup 2026 publishes an identified course and has a final for specified class winners from its venue events.
reference_facts.translation_insight: A season can connect course reveals, travel, rivalries and culminating qualification.

reference_facts.statement: The official 2026–27 guide combines a catalogue, build techniques, race preparation, rules and champion-machine galleries.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Create an in-world publication people use, collect, annotate and argue about.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya distinguishes continuously produced products, revived products, intermittently produced projects and genuinely limited releases.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Separate RRR brood availability and historic editions from performance quality.

reference_facts.statement: The layout sheet includes piece lists, footprints and routes assembled from differing numbers of circuit sets, including historic recreations.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Track plans are reproducible construction recipes and collectible hobby artifacts.

reference_facts.statement: Tamiya publicly supports appearance contests, selected build galleries and interviews with successful appearance-contest entrants.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Craft and visual prestige can develop alongside race prestige.

reference_facts.statement: In Issus, paired hind-leg gears synchronize nymphal jumps; this gear mechanism is absent after the final molt to adulthood.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Life stage can change the kind of useful sect, not merely its item level.

reference_facts.statement: The participation guide distinguishes Family, Junior, Open and Trial categories, with differing eligibility and assembly arrangements.
reference_facts.translation_insight: Separate participant category from equipment class and competitive tier.

translation_rules.title: Function before renamed appearance
translation_rules.rule: Map a PCR part’s job, interactions, tuning choices and failure behavior before giving it an insect appearance.

translation_rules.title: Keep sources scoped
translation_rules.rule: A rule in Gaiden, a Tamiya event and an RRR class are different records even when their names match.

translation_rules.title: Shared biology, multiple acquisition routes
translation_rules.rule: Wild sourcing, home breeding and Wrangloid retail feed the same specimen and sect systems.

translation_rules.title: Real upgrades are allowed
translation_rules.rule: Do not impose an artificial drawback on every improvement. Good stock and clever engineering can outperform earlier stock.

translation_rules.title: Price is not truth
translation_rules.rule: Asking price, measured performance, pedigree evidence, rarity and condition are separate fields.

translation_rules.title: Anatomy is not a loot table
translation_rules.rule: A donor’s usable pieces, stage and remaining state must agree with actual preparation events.

translation_rules.title: Assemblies are compositional
translation_rules.rule: An integrated hopper leg can include support, leverage and spring response. Count those contributions once, not again as hidden bonuses.

translation_rules.title: Compatibility is expressed
translation_rules.rule: Where proposed geometry prevents a combination, specify the interference and allow redesign rather than inventing a species gate.

translation_rules.title: Products differ from individuals
translation_rules.rule: A kit recipe or breeder line is repeatable; each live specimen and assembled racer has its own identity and history.

translation_rules.title: Victory enters the world
translation_rules.rule: Results create records and opportunities; subsequent reputation and demand travel through identified people and media.

translation_rules.title: Depth is elective
translation_rules.rule: A kit-only racer, specialist collector and full-time breeder each have complete routes to meaningful enjoyment and progress.

translation_rules.title: Thirty years has layers
translation_rules.rule: Write hobby history using relative sport years while leaving the apocalypse’s date unresolved.

translation_rules.title: Fictional uncertainty is typed
translation_rules.rule: A rumor, a merchant claim, a measured observation and author-established truth must not collapse into one fact.

translation_rules.title: Physical resemblance is insufficient
translation_rules.rule: A gear-looking spine is not a gearbox; a passive foil is not a flight engine; a familiar name is not a functional model.

decisions.title: Survival chronology and biosphere
decisions.consequences: Determines why people, donors and roaches coexist, and what feeds settlements.
decisions.proposed_direction: Keep sport age separate from apocalypse age. Retain roach survival as the premise; resolve the return or survival of other life explicitly.
unapproved_assumptions: All life other than roaches literally ceased to exist

decisions.title: Creature and venue scale
decisions.consequences: Controls carrying cases, tool handling, camera, tank density, track pieces and spectacle.
decisions.proposed_direction: Use a bench-built, hand-carried hobby as a working visual anchor; leave millimeter values unset until a scale study.
unapproved_assumptions: Every race is an arena of human-sized mounts

decisions.title: Assimilation operation and timing
decisions.consequences: Controls wild grafting, prepared kits, reconfiguration and experimentation.
decisions.proposed_direction: Raw sects and prepared sects use the same underlying mutation; preparation supplies convenience, fit and information.
unapproved_assumptions: Proprietary collars required to make assimilation possible
Instant or multi-day integration already settled

decisions.title: Removal, storage and reinstallation
decisions.consequences: Controls component collection, used markets, bench swapping and maintenance.
decisions.proposed_direction: Track removed, prepared and installed states distinctly; specify preservation and damage only after the life-cycle model is chosen.

decisions.title: Heredity and breeding compatibility
decisions.consequences: Controls commercial lines, host identity and accidental infinite reproduction of builds.
decisions.proposed_direction: Retain the v0.2 separation of acquired grafts and inherited lineage as the current working branch.
unapproved_assumptions: Installed assemblies copied perfectly into offspring

decisions.title: Life stages and usable anatomy
decisions.consequences: Controls catching seasons, stage-specific stock, breeding parents and preparation opportunities.
decisions.proposed_direction: Describe stage-specific anatomy per donor. Do not require every family to share a simple growing rarity ladder.
unapproved_assumptions: Adult is always the only valuable stage

decisions.title: Injury, recovery, aging and permanent loss
decisions.consequences: Controls emotional attachment, preparation demand, risk, competition formats and accessibility.
decisions.proposed_direction: Evaluate repair/recovery and high-risk event alternatives explicitly; do not silently set a global death model.
unapproved_assumptions: Imported real lifespans are game timers

decisions.title: Locomotion, senses and player intervention
decisions.consequences: Controls whether the host is a creature, control input depth, training and observable racing behavior.
decisions.proposed_direction: Provide an autonomous race plan as a candidate. Resolve live cues and behavioral inheritance before adding them to kit requirements.

decisions.title: Calendar and simulation clocks
decisions.consequences: Controls hatching, market delivery, event schedules and catch availability.
decisions.proposed_direction: Declare world time, active-play time and optional time advancement separately. Beginners can use shop stock without becoming breeders.
unapproved_assumptions: Waiting is the only way to breed

decisions.title: Trade and communications
decisions.consequences: Controls how live stock travels and how distant people learn about winners.
decisions.proposed_direction: Prototype protected live-stock routes, local handbills and intermittent regional broadcasts.
unapproved_assumptions: A collapsed world has no working maintenance industry

decisions.title: Faction representation and Derby jurisdiction
decisions.consequences: Controls who selects representatives, recognizes results and protects visiting racers.
decisions.proposed_direction: Factionals award representation; recognition of race results can be narrower than political friendship.
unapproved_assumptions: A faction grants exclusive biological compatibility

decisions.title: Event standards and extraordinary builds
decisions.consequences: Controls Open freedom, flight boundaries, course validity and disputes.
decisions.proposed_direction: Separate locomotion division, equipment policy, qualification and race format; inspect only relevant declared conditions.
unapproved_assumptions: No-holds-barred means no start or finish rules
Every nominal slot permits only one physical item

rules.statement: Every addition must specify an origin function, a player decision, a changed world state, an observable consequence and at least one downstream use.
Classify the origin as source-hobby translation, Mewgenics-inspired progression, or RRR-native biological/derby extension; do not fabricate 1:1 antecedents for breeding tanks or insect weapons.
Preserve speed, race victories, personally assembled kits, valuable collections, genuine upgrades and unrestricted hobby participation as simultaneous goals.
All new rules are versioned design proposals. Revisions identify the affected traits, products, facilities, recipes and tests rather than silently rewriting ancestry or race history.
No racing rank gates the existence of a donor, its genes, catching permission or reproductive competence.
Different career interests share one physical inventory. They are not exclusive skill classes.
Published measurement and pedigree confidence are separate from true internal state; a missing measurement is unknown, not zero.
No claim is made that Mewgenics succeeds solely because of breeding, or that RRR engagement is established by this document.
Evaluate an insect independently as an immediate race donor, a breeder, a sale item, and a collectible; do not flatten those roles into one rarity number.
Heritable anatomy, developmental condition, temporary state, preparation quality and fitted geometry are different causes of performance.
A common animal can carry exceptional useful alleles; an uncommon form can be an ordinary racer; a rare specimen may be excellent in multiple dimensions.

Permit genuine Pareto improvements: a new sect may improve useful output without a compensating penalty. Keep meaningful search through further combinations, demand and frontier content, not forced drawbacks on every upgrade.
A damaged donor can retain reproductive value if its reproductive anatomy and condition allow breeding; do not assume every injury permits or prevents reproduction.
A visibly outstanding donor need not breed reliably. Fecundity, viability and offspring consistency are production traits distinct from racing traits.
A line sold as consistent needs demonstrated offspring results across multiple broods; pedigree is evidence, not a magical performance multiplier.
Sale prices depend on buyer purpose, acceptance criteria, available money and demand; grade and color do not dictate universal prices.
Hobby, Club, Circuit, Premier and Apex remain display bands from the prior proposal; classify using declared tests within a component family, not player level or an inherited rarity label.
A field objective names a donor or trait, a use, a target life stage and a plausible search route before departure; general collecting remains allowed.
Habitat changes encounter composition and possible population trait distributions; it does not apply a free stat buff for being captured there.
For each fictional population, author both an ordinary distribution and an exceptional tail; do not reserve all interesting outcomes for new map tiers.
Tracks, calls, molts, feeding marks and repeated movement are evidence of presence or phenotype, never guaranteed proof of a hidden genotype.
Use route, time window, weather and search method to target encounters; exceptional capture is not a reward generated after generic combat.
Separate encountering, detecting, approaching, containing, and transporting a specimen. Skill or equipment can change a particular stage without upgrading its genome.
Capture tools declare which desired structures they are likely to preserve: rigid individual pods protect legs and wings; communal bulk boxes trade space efficiency against contact damage.
Transport consumes capacity and affects condition. Fragile stock, live predators and mixed stages need appropriate separation; capacities are physical units, not rarity weights.
Ordinary catches have declared common customers, kit uses or lawful feed-input channels; unmarketable or unsuitable specimens may have no profitable outlet.
A repeatable field route can pay through ordinary stock while exceptional finds supply improvement and larger gains. This is a balance target, not a guaranteed profit rule.
Population refresh is driven by the world clock, local cohorts and authored recovery; leaving and reentering a map is not a new instantaneous generation.
Capture scarcity can motivate alternative routes, trading and breeding; avoid mandatory real-time daily visits or disappearance because the player stopped playing.
Field runs settle retained animals, losses, consumed supplies, cash and observations separately; a journal entry is not ownership of a specimen.
Source location and old field records remain useful after discovery: later projects may require different stages, unrelated founders, or previously ignored traits.
On return, place captures in holding and preserve identities; only then allocate each animal to keep, assay, pair, grow, prepare, sell, display, or release.
Quick-sell evaluates the selected market and excludes locked breeders, protected founders, unresolved project matches and named collectibles by default; players may deliberately override.
Unidentified stock can be sold as unidentified. A knowledgeable customer can value it differently; the game does not disclose unmeasured genotype solely through a precise sale-price oracle.
A brood summary groups ordinary specimens but keeps individually valuable animals inspectable; batch actions preserve their distinct IDs.
Repeated standardized assays reduce uncertainty; a single warmed-up, injured or recently fed performance is labeled with those conditions.
Breeding and assay reservations are exclusive resource allocations. A specimen cannot simultaneously be shipped to a customer and used locally as a parent.
An offspring chosen as a replacement breeder does not count as cash income; it becomes retained productive inventory.
Selling a rare but redundant animal is a valid strategic choice; keeping every rare specimen is not compulsory progression.
Each donor form has a declared reproduction profile. Universal graft assimilation does not imply universal crossbreeding.

For the initial fictional model, pair-breeding forms use a small diploid genome with quantitative loci, discrete anatomy loci and optional linked groups. Colony forms use an explicit colony-parent profile; their exact inheritance expansion is deferred.
A quantitative trait derives from allele effects, possible dominance, interactions, development and condition. Do not use max(parent A, parent B) as the default inheritance rule.
Installed donor grafts do not automatically enter the host germline in this working branch. Host breeding and donor breeding remain linked but distinct projects.
Trait potential is sampled or inherited at creation; catching, renaming, selling and retesting do not reroll it.
Only a declared new mutation can introduce an allele absent from both parents. Rare alleles can also enter a project through unrelated wild founders or trade.
Discrete morphology can change a module action, not merely a stat: examples include a forked horn, a split spray outlet or an asymmetric-looking but functional vane.
Fertility determines successful reproductive opportunity; clutch size determines eggs or offspring initiated; viability and rearing determine survivors. These are not the same number.
A failed pairing consumes the specified time and supplies but does not automatically kill both parents or confiscate an unrelated rare gene.
A production line is stabilized against named acceptance criteria, not against every possible trait; true-breeding target loci do not make all descendants identical.
Relatedness is tracked. Inherited recessive defects and declared reproductive profiles determine consequences; a universal guaranteed bad-stat penalty for every related pair is not assumed.
Line breeding and outcrossing are both available. The former can fix useful traits; the latter can introduce missing traits and reduce shared recessive risks while reopening variation.
A breeding project reserves founder stock, tests offspring and records observed outcomes. It should permit meaningful partial successes rather than treating every non-perfect child as garbage.
Measured averages and confidence belong in the player view; exact allele displays are an optional assay/progression design, not presumed beginner knowledge.
Living breeders are consumable productive capacity through time, condition and eventual replacement. Absolute lifespan and permanent-loss policies remain in a separate decision branch.
A breeding tank is a physical assembly of shell, climate control, substrate, partitions, feed/water delivery, reproductive surfaces, handling access and monitoring.
A tank recipe defines a useful starting configuration, not a rigid species-exclusive slot; a custom enclosure satisfying the same needs can work.
Distinguish adult holding, controlled mating, incubation, grow-out, isolation, performance assay and sect storage. A glass box does not perform all jobs automatically.
Climate, density and nutrition affect declared development and viability parameters; they do not directly award inherited speed points.
Partitions improve parentage control and protect incompatible occupants, sometimes reducing capacity. More equipment is not automatically more usable floor area.
Grow-out capacity can be the bottleneck even when mating space is empty. Breeding forecasts include the future cohort, not just the present adults.
Fertility support increases productive attempts or reduces environmental failure only as specified; it does not select the best allele at conception.
Stage-control equipment slows or schedules development at a real resource or throughput cost; it does not suspend life indefinitely for free.
Automatic mating plans execute only with mature, compatible, unreserved parents, supplies and a place for the forecast cohort; otherwise report the blocking condition.
Automatic production stops starting new batches when safe capacity or feed reserve is insufficient. Already committed offspring remain visible obligations.
Facilities continue during other in-world activities. Default offline behavior in this wave is paused world time; alternative capped offline advancement remains an explicit option.
Fast-forwarding in-world time advances upkeep, development, orders and market replenishment together. Advancing only profits is forbidden.
Care services and automation let a larger business reduce clicks. They consume labor or upkeep; advanced growth should increase strategic choices rather than repeated manual feeding.
A warning is not an immunity: proceeding with incompatible conditions can waste a clutch, damage stock or cause escape according to the declared profile.
Present basic readiness and forecast output first; expose detailed climate, density, pedigree and variance panels on demand.
A harvest plan lists the exact anatomy transferred and the changed donor state. Multiple products from one donor are allowed only where their physical sources do not overlap.
A complete Hopper set can include limb spars, springs and launch anatomy; installing it does not also grant free duplicate suspension and gear items.
Preparation can preserve quality, establish a mounting interface or alter geometry; it does not automatically increase the inherited potential of every processed part.
Raw grafting remains possible under the universal assimilation premise; prepared kits trade money and work for reliable fit, known geometry and convenience.
A prepared sect has a donor ID, anatomy inventory, condition, configuration range and storage requirements independent of its product name.
The assembly bench changes posture, leverage, clearance, mounting angle and placement. These settings are authored by the builder, not inherited by its offspring.
Keep the actual racer-building sequence visible and optional-depth: guided assembly for a kit; editable components and subassemblies for specialists.
Universal compatibility is biological; interference, unsupported load and blocked motion are physical problems to solve rather than hidden species bans.
Removal can make a sect available again only through the chosen removal/viability rules; no silent duplication or complete loss is presumed.
Native anatomy continues providing essential functions wherever it has not been replaced; starting roaches are functional animals.
A configuration is race-legal because of its actual capabilities and event rules, not because a seller renamed its attack module as a stabilizer.
Measurements compare the same load, energy state and surface where possible; the race remains the competitive outcome, not a substitute for a controlled component assay.
Every effect declares cause, target, operation, magnitude or formula reference, trigger, duration, resource draw, stacking family, removability, inheritance and event legality.
Use four separate categories: inherited anatomy; developmental quality; fitted setup; temporary state. Do not repeatedly count one property as all four.
Fuel loading changes usable reserve and carried mass; it is not an unexplained multiplicative speed buff.
Warm-up changes readiness and consumes reserve; overheating or fatigue follows only the declared physiological model.
Surface conditioning and grooming can restore or alter contact behavior; their effects are not copied into offspring.
An interaction bonus must identify a mechanism such as timing tolerance, energy delivery or joint fit. Matching donor species names alone is not sufficient.
Stacking resolves against shared resources: two high-draw organs share available delivery, rather than each receiving the full capacity independently.
One action may produce multiple consequences, but an energy store cannot be spent twice by simultaneous abilities.
Persistent experience is recorded separately from mutation. Heritable skill transfer requires a specific designed mechanism, not borrowing it from Mewgenics without translation.
No premium kit automatically receives an invisible bundle of buffs; show the parts, preparation or settings that supply its benefits.
Income routes include ordinary field supply, prepared sects, selected breeders, recurring brood contracts, custom kits, fitting, testing, boarding and race prizes.
A livelihood can cover food, housing/workshop costs and maintenance without championship wins; different routes still have distinct risk, labor and capital needs.
Recurring income requires useful stock, a productive facility, supplies, a production schedule and real customers. A tank is not a money generator disconnected from inventory.
Standing orders state accepted form, stage, traits, condition, quantity, price, delivery window, substitution rules and cancellation conditions.
Unsold stock is inventory, not revenue. Listed prices are not completed transactions.
Contracts and ordinary customers have funded demand and finite acceptance; saturation affects actual offers, not a hidden universal penalty on every player business.
Selling to distant demand can improve realized value while adding transport, delay and handling risk. Regions are market contexts, not mandatory tier locks.
Protect retained founders and reserve stock before automated sale. Every automated decision is inspectable and reversible before commitment where the operation permits.
A special breeding trait such as higher viable yield can make an ordinary race donor commercially exceptional; production expertise earns money in its own right.
Capital upgrades change throughput, output consistency, reachable donor profiles or labor needs. They do not automatically increase the market price of unchanged insects.
Race success can create attention, demand and sponsorship but is not proof that a donor line caused the result or that every offspring will win.
A broker can buy an ordinary intact insect, prepare multiple disjoint products and earn a margin; the model includes the original acquisition, supplies, time and sale capacity.
Repeat trading between identical buy/sell quotes cannot create money from nowhere. Profitable resale requires a real difference in place, timing, work, information or accepted stock.
Cash operating margin, retained inventory, replacement reserves and capital spending are separate ledger quantities.
The market need not punish every surplus with zero value; common-stock outlets should be designed deliberately and funded consistently with the economy.
Open permits extreme equipment combinations without a universal point budget; course completion, locomotion division and event validity still apply.
Speedsters excludes dedicated weapons but allows native contact. Useful body or movement changes are not forbidden merely because collisions can hurt.
Fireworks requires functional minimum offense and light carapace. A heavy support structure that provides prohibited armor cannot evade inspection through labeling.
Flyers race flyers; sustained flight and hopping are classified by declared capability tests, not donor species name alone.
Competition tier does not dictate whether a gene can exist. Later tiers can feature stronger opponents, larger prizes and more demanding or varied race conditions.
A kit-class event is an optional additional format; a beginner can also use an appropriate horn, hopper or flying kit in another legal event.
Both genuine raw-speed upgrades and ingenious combinations can win races. Do not design every new part to be a compulsory correction for a scripted obstacle.
The championship ladder remains Locals, Regionals, Factionals, and faction representation at New World City for the What’s Left of the World Derby.
Rewards include money, useful stock, facilities, parts, access to customers, public recognition and qualifications; no event must award every reward type.
Breeding and business can progress alongside racing. A profitable business can finance a stronger racer; the racer can advertise a useful breeding line.
Trackmaker and hosting progression uses owned modular pieces, valid layouts and event participation; it does not require pretending that breeding tanks existed in PCR.
Controlled course and component tests explain performance, while finish order determines the race. Winning remains an exciting achievement in its own right.
High-value decisions include retaining versus extracting a founder, specializing versus maintaining a second line, and accepting a deadline versus keeping enough rearing capacity.
Failure can consume a capture opportunity, supplies, a brood, a contract payment or a race result. The cause must be attributable to a stated rule or disclosed uncertainty.
Punishment does not require destroying unrelated systems at once; a failed order does not automatically erase the workshop and the champion.
Do not guarantee every expedition, pairing or business produces profit. Preserve practical lower-capital ways to recover after an unsuccessful ambitious project.
Protecting parents and raising backup stock is a strategic hedge, not mandatory busywork; production presets may manage it.
The default wave branch adds no new global host permadeath rule. Donor extraction consequences are explicit; racer aging and permanent loss remain a separate decision.
Never force the player to leave the game open or return on a real-world schedule to keep protected stock alive in the default clock model.
Avoid obtaining engagement solely through repeated identical clicks, invisible probabilities or arbitrary new restrictions. Measure interesting choices and meaningful improvements in later playtests.

traits.name: Juvenile useful-window breadth

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Increases scheduling tolerance and saleable stage yield.

traits.name: Peel release

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Allows faster foot cycling without abandoning grip.

traits.name: Fouling recovery

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Maintains useful contact on dusty courses.

traits.name: Hip leverage

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Provides lowstep acceleration or load delivery.

traits.name: Cleat purchase

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Improves drive on ash and grit.

traits.name: Joint sealing
traits.measurement: grit ingress after a standardized exposure
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Preserves articulation on dirty tracks.

traits.name: Limb leverage
traits.measurement: effective stride reach per drive cycle
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Changes distance per working stroke.

traits.name: Distal mass
traits.measurement: moving foot-end mass at a stated reach
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Reduces limb cycling demand.

traits.name: Tip release
traits.measurement: surface-release delay at specified load
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Supports high stride frequency.

traits.name: Reserve density
traits.measurement: usable energy per tissue mass
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Extends running for the same storage mass.

traits.name: Release conductance
traits.measurement: maximum output through the prepared interface
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Supports more demanding drive without starving it.

traits.name: Tissue damping

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Supports a deliberately prepared moving-mass damper.

traits.name: Crop delivery
traits.measurement: maximum supported delivery per outlet area
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Supports sprint bursts and repeated active abilities.

traits.name: Crop capacity
traits.measurement: usable fluid volume at a stated tissue mass
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Extends burst availability.

traits.name: Colony throughput
traits.measurement: usable donor workers produced per provision unit
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Improves recurring crop-stock supply.

traits.name: Closure latency
traits.measurement: time from trigger to contact at stated reach
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Improves interception and catching opportunity.

traits.name: Grasp leverage
traits.measurement: holding force for given muscle input
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Maintains a catch against resistance.

traits.name: Reach retention
traits.measurement: usable reach without losing specified closure rate
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Extends control envelope.

traits.name: Root strength
traits.measurement: load before failure at a stated horn mass
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Transfers a harder charge through the mounting base.

traits.name: Hook geometry
traits.measurement: curvature/reach/lift angle
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Changes whether contact lifts, pushes or glances.

traits.name: Impact retention

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Sustains repeated attacks.

traits.name: Pulse consistency
traits.measurement: variation in output per activation
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Makes attack delivery repeatable.

traits.name: Reservoir recharge
traits.measurement: time or resource needed to restore a pulse

traits.name: Valve durability

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Maintains safe self-contained operation.

traits.name: Wing efficiency

traits.race_or_production_consequence: Changes maneuverability and control.

traits.name: Root endurance
traits.measurement: supported wingbeat cycles under load
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Maintains flight capability through repeated races.

traits.name: Vane stiffness
traits.measurement: deflection under standard airflow load
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Controls passive pitch surface response.

traits.name: Deployment response
traits.measurement: time to open a folded surface
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Improves on-demand braking response.

traits.name: Felt friction
traits.measurement: drag against a stated substrate
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Changes ventral contact-brake strength.

traits.name: Rotation sensitivity
traits.measurement: smallest resolved angular disturbance
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Detects smaller changes in body attitude.

traits.name: Signal latency
traits.measurement: delay from disturbance to usable host signal
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Starts an available corrective action sooner.

traits.name: Pair calibration
traits.measurement: left-right sensor mismatch
traits.race_or_production_consequence: Reduces biased corrections.

traits.race_or_production_consequence: More productive attempts with the same mating space.

acceptance_tests.criterion: Player can name a trait, explain a racing or commercial use, choose a plausible habitat, and identify what observation would justify keeping the catch.
An ordinary capture has at least one defined buyer or personal use; not every specimen is guaranteed a profitable sale.
An injured-but-reproductive or modest-performing specimen can still be correctly retained for useful inherited potential.
Complementary founders can produce a meaningful multigeneration project; perfect offspring are neither guaranteed nor locked behind player rank.
A superior drive or contact part can be genuinely superior on relevant measurements without an obligatory compensating drawback.
Each enclosure upgrade changes an operational variable and names an affected cohort; no +speed from decorative furniture without a specified mechanism.
Each brood and capture updates identity, anatomy, ownership and stage; preparation and sale cannot duplicate specimens.
Standing orders only pay for accepted delivered stock; unsold output remains inventory and overhead continues.
Autosale preserves marked founders, reserved replacements and project matches; breeder retention is excluded from cash revenue.
Progressing time advances costs and obligations together with production; starting more broods than capacity supports is a visible decision.
A kit requires selecting/placing its real components; buying or breeding does not bypass the build-it-yourself identity.
Functional weapon and armor checks distinguish Open, Speedsters, Fireworks and Flyers without hidden rarity or species bans.
Rare capture genes and old race-result configurations do not change when retested or when a catalogue grade threshold is updated.
A shop-bought kit racer, a field catcher and a production breeder can each make progress without being forced into the other two activities.
Playtests must test enjoyment, meaningful loss, genuine improvement and livelihoods; passing data tests is not a substitute.

systems.title: Reference and development scope

rules.statement: Source-hobby function, RRR translation and new extension are separate fields.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Trace a mechanic before adding it.
rules.observable_consequence: A tank is not falsely attributed to PCR; a muscle still has a motor-related purpose.

rules.statement: The same trait identifier must connect field observations, breeding goals, accepted products and controlled performance tests.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Change a trait once and inspect all dependents.
rules.observable_consequence: A breeding improvement cannot secretly become an unrelated race bonus.

rules.statement: No fixed scoring weights, grade boundaries or acronym expansion are invented for MIVIM.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use recovered guardrails and separate criterion findings.
rules.observable_consequence: Unsupported numerical grades are absent.

rules.statement: Conventional validation work protects the novel contribution but cannot substitute for it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Report contribution role and evidence at its own scope.
rules.observable_consequence: A schema test is not claimed as delivered gameplay innovation.

rules.statement: All new numeric profiles are named revisioned fixtures; existing nulls remain unresolved outside that profile.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a profile explicitly.
rules.observable_consequence: A hopper test duration does not become every insect species lifecycle.

rules.statement: Original user premises outrank generated handbooks; new waves do not silently promote proposals into canon.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Resolve conflicts with authority and explicit amendments.
rules.observable_consequence: Open remains open; any hobbyist may catch and breed.

systems.title: Project-led intake and evidence

rules.statement: A project names a desired product or specimen use, target traits, current evidence, missing complement and spending or capacity limit.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Create a sprint, breeding, supply or collection project.
rules.observable_consequence: The player can explain why an animal is useful before keeping it.

rules.statement: A complementary breeder is judged against the current project, not solely its own aggregate race performance.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Retain a low-return high-synchrony hopper for a high-return line.
rules.observable_consequence: An otherwise ordinary capture may advance a specific breeding objective.

rules.statement: Intake recommendations read only the observations and knowledge visible to that decision maker.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Inspect, test or buy knowledge.
rules.observable_consequence: Two unseen genotypes with the same visible evidence receive the same default recommendation.

rules.statement: An observation records protocol, condition, load, stage, value bounds, time and method; bounds are not called confidence intervals without a model.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare compatible measurements.
rules.observable_consequence: A field glimpse and controlled assay remain visibly different evidence.

rules.statement: A demonstrated match, possible match and ruled-out target are distinct; unknown is not zero or automatic success.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Review uncertainty instead of accepting a fabricated exact answer.
rules.observable_consequence: A possible useful donor is flagged, not certified.

rules.statement: Explicit founder, replacement, collectible and order protections precede bulk sale recommendations.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Set or release a protection deliberately.
rules.observable_consequence: Quick-sale previews exclude protected stock.

rules.statement: Possible project matches request review without creating permanent unremovable locks.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Snooze a project, dismiss a match or override the current batch.
rules.observable_consequence: A full holding case can be cleared without deleting the whole project.

rules.statement: The quick route permits buying a coordinated kit and racing; assay and breeding are optional activities.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose the depth of participation.
rules.observable_consequence: Basic participation does not require learning allele notation.

rules.statement: Prices reflect buyer purpose and available evidence, not a hidden exact-genotype price oracle.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a buyer or better evidence for a sale.
rules.observable_consequence: Unidentified stock can be sold honestly as unidentified.

rules.statement: Run planning stores target donor, stage, habitat, observable sign, capture method, space, ordinary-stock outlet and source of the claim.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a purposeful route.
rules.observable_consequence: A trip has a useful ordinary result as well as exceptional targets, without guaranteed profit.

systems.title: Selection and phenotype production

rules.statement: The Wave 03 witness uses three independent diploid hopper loci for return, synchrony and settling; it does not generalize to colony donors.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Apply the named fixture only to its declared scope.
rules.observable_consequence: Unavailable colony formulas stay unavailable.

rules.statement: Offspring inherit one allele per parent per locus in this fixture; mutation, linkage and reproductive failure are separately configured, not implied.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose parents with complementary contributions.
rules.observable_consequence: The support of possible offspring is enumerable and does not default to parental maxima.

rules.statement: Genotype potential, developmental expression, current condition, preparation and mounting remain separate records.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Correct the relevant cause of a disappointing result.
rules.observable_consequence: Remounting a part does not rewrite its pedigree.

rules.statement: A founder contribution may matter across generations even when first-generation offspring do not meet the final target.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose immediate donor use versus intermediate breeding stock.
rules.observable_consequence: A failed premium target can still produce useful ordinary assemblies.

rules.statement: Breeding forecasts state what they are conditional on, including initiated count, survival, assay and delivery window.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Decide whether a forecast supports a promise.
rules.observable_consequence: A conditional one-in-sixteen genotype chance is never shown as a guaranteed sale rate.

rules.statement: Project forecasts use compatible observations or explicit tested genotype knowledge; engine-truth enumeration is a debug witness, not default UI.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Acquire relevant evidence rather than access omniscient suggestions.
rules.observable_consequence: The breeder panel can state insufficient evidence.

rules.statement: A demonstrated line claim names protocol, trait acceptance, tested count, brood identities and dates; one winning racer does not certify a line.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Publish a narrow reproducibility claim.
rules.observable_consequence: Customers can distinguish a sample observation from a guarantee.

rules.statement: Fertility, initiated young, surviving young, saleable young and retained replacements are counted separately.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Improve the bottleneck the business actually has.
rules.observable_consequence: A larger clutch may not increase saleable output.

rules.statement: A project may target production reliability or appearance instead of maximal race output.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Breed for wholesale, collection or a competitive build.
rules.observable_consequence: Modest racing stock can be the preferred commercial parent.

rules.statement: Each batch has a stable event-local outcome seed in the implementation witness; unrelated actions and view refreshes do not reroll it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Replay or inspect without changing ancestry.
rules.observable_consequence: Splitting a clock advance does not change the cohort.

systems.title: Future capacity and delayed cohorts

rules.statement: A production commitment reserves identified parents, mating time, incubation, grow-out, transition space and planned output handling.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Inspect the full path before starting another brood.
rules.observable_consequence: An empty mating compartment does not conceal full future grow-out.

rules.statement: Capacity claims use resource-specific physical or declared fixture units and half-open intervals [start,end).
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare overlapping occupancy on the same resource.
rules.observable_consequence: A departing cohort and arriving cohort can share a boundary without double occupancy.

rules.statement: The safe preset reserves the bounded initiated cohort count, not merely expected survivors; risk-taking overflow plans must name actual capacity or services.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Pay for capacity or accept a declared alternative.
rules.observable_consequence: A probability forecast cannot manufacture physical space.

rules.statement: A multi-resource reservation commits atomically or not at all.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Attempt a new plan.
rules.observable_consequence: Failure does not strand a parent reservation or consume half the supplies.

rules.statement: A delay to a living cohort preserves the actual animals and their occupancy.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Reschedule later production or acquire overflow.
rules.observable_consequence: Living young are not deleted because a spreadsheet says their stage ended.

rules.statement: When a delay conflicts only with unstarted jobs, pause those whole jobs and release their unspent reservations for replanning.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Review which future contracts require revision.
rules.observable_consequence: No unstarted job retains hidden partial resources.

rules.statement: A conflict between two existing living cohorts requires actual relocation or other declared handling; the witness refuses to pretend that pausing resolves it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Arrange supported overflow or a stated consequence.
rules.observable_consequence: The unimplemented relocation path is flagged, not silently credited as safe.

rules.statement: Starting costs, ongoing care, deadlines, maturation and actual settlement use the same world clock.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Race, travel or fast-forward while production operates.
rules.observable_consequence: Waiting advances costs as well as opportunities.

rules.statement: Default offline behavior remains paused world time; no return schedule is imposed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Leave the game without maintaining a real-world appointment.
rules.observable_consequence: Real time alone does not kill or feed stock in the default branch.

rules.statement: Mature stock still needs holding; storage and replacement space remain obligations after grow-out.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Reserve output handling rather than ending the schedule at maturity.
rules.observable_consequence: Production completion does not free space occupied by unsold animals.

rules.statement: Pausing new production does not pause care for existing stock.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Protect working capital or pay for help.
rules.observable_consequence: A stopped business remains responsible for living inventory.

systems.title: Anatomy, components and kit assembly

rules.statement: An anatomy token identifies a physical donor region; extraction transfers it from that individual to a prepared component.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a harvest plan.
rules.observable_consequence: The same hind joint cannot remain simultaneously on the live donor and in a kit.

rules.statement: A complete multi-role assembly contributes its physical structures once, regardless of the number of functional roles it covers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use a whole Hopper set or a subassembly.
rules.observable_consequence: Hind limbs, jump and landing roles do not multiply mass, price or stock count.

rules.statement: Alternative harvest plans sharing anatomy are exclusive; disjoint plans can coexist.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a complete hopper or separated joint product; allocate scarab tissues independently where possible.
rules.observable_consequence: One donor can supply several honest products without duplicated loot.

rules.statement: Protected parents require explicit release before irreversible preparation.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Trade future reproductive value for immediate use deliberately.
rules.observable_consequence: Automation cannot casually consume the sole retained founder.

rules.statement: Vital extraction changes the donor living state; nonvital extraction still changes anatomy and condition.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Select the preparation and retained stock.
rules.observable_consequence: A body record surviving in the database is not proof its animal remains intact.

rules.statement: A packaged kit owns custody of its components; loose-component sale or installation first requires a declared unpack operation.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep, sell, unpack or assemble the kit.
rules.observable_consequence: A packaged part cannot be sold separately while the kit remains complete.

rules.statement: Buying a kit transfers its real contents and recipe; assembly remains an actual sequence using those contents.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Place and fit the parts personally or use the supported guided process.
rules.observable_consequence: A purchased tin is not an instant unearned assembled racer.

rules.statement: Installation changes component custody and the named host configuration, not its germline.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Fit a new graft.
rules.observable_consequence: The host retains identity and its inherited genome.

rules.statement: Geometry feasibility and event legality are separate, capability-based results.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Solve interference or choose another legal event.
rules.observable_consequence: Horn-and-foil combinations are not banned by a returning one-brow-slot rule.

rules.statement: A failed multi-asset commit leaves ownership, money and custody unchanged.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Correct the missing item and retry.
rules.observable_consequence: No partial kit or sale is silently committed.

systems.title: Funded orders and earned operating margin

rules.statement: A firm standing order reserves actual buyer funds for its remaining accepted quantity.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Accept a funded commitment rather than an unfunded asking price.
rules.observable_consequence: A visible order has a finite budget; escrow is not seller revenue.

rules.statement: A casual spot sale can settle immediately; the standing-order path does not add compulsory waiting to every transaction.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose immediate sale or production contracting.
rules.observable_consequence: The ordinary return-and-sell loop remains accessible.

rules.statement: Order acceptance uses product identity, declared evidence and condition policy; engine-hidden genotype is not an undeclared acceptance requirement.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Test, substitute by agreement or sell in another channel.
rules.observable_consequence: A known ordinary product can be accepted without pedigree certification.

rules.statement: Delivery transfers accepted assets and payment together; repeated event IDs replay the original receipt without a second payment.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Commit or retry a delivery.
rules.observable_consequence: Reloading or double-clicking cannot generate extra income.

rules.statement: A repeated transaction key with a different payload is rejected.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Submit a genuinely new action with a new identity.
rules.observable_consequence: Retries cannot be repurposed into unlogged changes.

rules.statement: Remaining escrow returns to the buyer when the order closes under its cancellation terms.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Cancel or settle the outstanding obligation.
rules.observable_consequence: Unspent funds do not become a cancellation profit.

rules.statement: Delivery at the stated final tick is valid before end-of-tick expiry; transport arrival is not assumed at dispatch.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Plan arrival rather than merely shipment.
rules.observable_consequence: Deadline boundaries have one reproducible interpretation.

rules.statement: Cash received, operating payments, unsold stock, retained productive stock, earmarks and capital purchases are distinct quantities.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose reinvestment while preserving care money.
rules.observable_consequence: A brood summary cannot count a retained breeder as both sale and inventory.

rules.statement: A product sale uses a funded customer; market replenishment requires a declared demand and budget source outside the closed fixture.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Find recurring customers or new markets.
rules.observable_consequence: Advancing time alone does not replenish every buyer wallet infinitely.

rules.statement: Cash planning includes incurred and future care; inability to start a new brood does not erase current obligations.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Hold a working reserve, reduce new starts or buy services.
rules.observable_consequence: An advertised margin does not imply affordable growth.

rules.statement: Low quality relative to one project can still have ordinary kit, service or collector demand; no universal profitable outlet is guaranteed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose the relevant buyer or retain stock.
rules.observable_consequence: Selling surplus is useful without turning every animal into fixed cash.

rules.statement: Every monetary figure in the supplied integration is a fixture with initial assets and omitted costs disclosed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use it to check consistency, not predict final profits.
rules.observable_consequence: A positive single cohort is not declared a sustainable economy.

systems.title: Trait-to-part and part-to-run contracts

rules.statement: The reference-hobby distinction between drive output, leverage, contact and handling remains explicit.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose components affecting the intended mechanical variable.
rules.observable_consequence: A horn is not renamed as a motor; foot grip does not invent energy.

rules.statement: Each controlled comparison fixes host mass, reserve, surface, configuration and protocol except the stated changed input.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare a donor change or tuning action.
rules.observable_consequence: Measured changes are attributed to a declared cause.

rules.statement: The hopper fixture maps return to useful launch energy, timing error to transfer loss and settling tissue to recovery time.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Breed and fit the desired combination.
rules.observable_consequence: A selected assembly can improve several results at the same input energy.

rules.statement: Mounting error is a setup term separate from inherited timing.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Align a useful donor correctly.
rules.observable_consequence: A remount changes the result without improving its genes.

rules.statement: Drive cadence and stall force feed a loaded one-dimensional bench; leverage changes force and free stride speed in opposite directions.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Try a faster motor or different hip geometry.
rules.observable_consequence: A new drive can demonstrably run the same bench faster.

rules.statement: Shared delivery is allocated across simultaneous demands; no organ receives the whole supply independently.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Configure priorities or supply capacity in the eventual runtime.
rules.observable_consequence: Requested outputs cannot exceed declared delivery together.

rules.statement: Normalized fixtures have explicit units, input bounds and protocol versions; they are not claims about real insect scale.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Replace coefficients through calibration without rewriting history.
rules.observable_consequence: No physical speed or jump height is falsely asserted.

rules.statement: A component test is not a race result; the eventual course simulation must consume the same accepted trait contract.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Validate actual racing separately.
rules.observable_consequence: No fixture automatically grants a win, qualification or trophy.

rules.statement: Genuine improvements remain permitted without obligatory drawbacks.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep an exceptionally useful find.
rules.observable_consequence: Equal-mass, equal-input improvement is not arbitrarily weakened to force a tradeoff.

rules.statement: The ordinary purchase route can obtain the same functional quality as breeding; different acquisition routes change history and cost, not hidden performance multipliers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Buy, find or breed a good component.
rules.observable_consequence: A shop customer is not made intrinsically inferior to a breeder.

systems.title: Interaction and presentation contracts

rules.statement: The intake primary view has Keep, Review and Sale-candidate groups with a short reason for each assignment.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Handle a mixed case quickly.
rules.observable_consequence: Useful decisions are visible before advanced numbers.

rules.statement: Expert inspection expands observations, parentage evidence, anatomy, stage and project match without navigating to a disconnected application.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Investigate a promising specimen.
rules.observable_consequence: Depth is optional but immediately related to the same animal.

rules.statement: A brood card states current stage, next transition, live occupancy, future occupancy, reserved replacements and the first blocking condition.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Fix the actual constraint.
rules.observable_consequence: Full grow-out is not mislabeled as no breeding slot.

rules.statement: An earnings card shows received, spent, outstanding, retained and available-after-planned-care separately.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose reinvestment or a safer reserve.
rules.observable_consequence: Expected income is never styled as already spendable cash.

rules.statement: Batch actions preview affected identities and protections; routine care operates through chosen presets or services.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Approve a useful batch rather than repeat individual feeding clicks.
rules.observable_consequence: Large operations add strategic planning rather than proportional click burden.

rules.statement: Breeder marks, donor lineage, prepared anatomy and build identity remain visible in product cards and finished racers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Recognize and show the part that was earned.
rules.observable_consequence: The biological hobby identity survives optimization and batch processing.

rules.statement: A beautiful unusual specimen can be kept by preference without a racing justification; presentation and provenance have first-class fields.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Collect or finish a distinctive build.
rules.observable_consequence: The world is not reduced to one numeric optimizer.

rules.statement: No visual/usability polish is credited as rendered or playtested in this wave.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Carry the interaction specification to the next implementation.
rules.observable_consequence: Design ambition remains open rather than a text-only mockup being called finished UI.

systems.title: Versioning, testing and handoff

rules.statement: Append Wave 03 under development_waves and preserve all prior base records unchanged in canonical JSON content; retain the baseline file verbatim.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Load base history plus new records.
rules.observable_consequence: Existing IDs, source notes, seed records and old results do not disappear.

rules.statement: Each refinement names the prior rule or record; a active-view projection may select current versions without editing stored history.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Revise a field or predicate intentionally.
rules.observable_consequence: Catalogue changes cannot silently reroll stock.

rules.statement: Test structural integrity, adversarial operations, controlled mechanisms and complete gameplay as distinct evidence categories.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Report exactly what was run.
rules.observable_consequence: A model witness is not sold as a playable game.

rules.statement: Unknown quality or novelty findings cannot be compensated by more passed tests, lower complexity or faster output.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep the appropriate acceptance gate open.
rules.observable_consequence: No weighted average erases a hard guardrail failure.

rules.statement: The next primary task connects these same traits to an assembled racer on modular circuits with real outcomes, not an unrelated scoring layer.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Continue the development graph.
rules.observable_consequence: The supply game remains accountable to exciting racing.
