systems.title: The same specimen becomes the racing part

rules.statement: Compile a racer from one host, actual installed component identities, native anatomy, preparation and a saved setup.
rules.decision: Fit parts, then enter that configuration.
rules.observable: Purchase alone does not change racing performance.

rules.statement: An acquired part only changes a build after installation; acquisition history grants no hidden multiplier.
rules.decision: Buy, catch or breed a useful donor.
rules.observable: Equivalent finished anatomy performs equivalently under equal conditions.

rules.statement: A drive contributes cadence and useful force; leverage changes their delivery rather than adding a second motor.
rules.decision: Choose drive stock and hip geometry separately.
rules.observable: Acceleration and sustained pace change through the named variables.

rules.statement: A hopper contributes inherited return, phase and settling; preload and alignment remain builder choices.
rules.decision: Breed a better pair or remount the existing pair.
rules.observable: The comparison identifies which layer changed.

rules.statement: A multi-role graft contributes mass, tissue and capability once.
rules.decision: Keep a whole package or separate its subcomponents.
rules.observable: A hopper can serve jump and suspension roles without two free assemblies.

rules.statement: Race entry captures an immutable build snapshot and model/rules/course versions.
rules.decision: Commit the intended setup before the start.
rules.observable: Later edits do not alter an old win, trophy or provenance claim.

rules.statement: Normalized values remain local test profiles; absolute creature scale is not established by the solver.
rules.decision: Calibrate scale separately.
rules.observable: No normalized time is advertised as real seconds or a retail product guarantee.

systems.title: Club benches, borrowing and personal assembly

rules.statement: A club bench supplies tools, fixtures, space and advice, not an exclusive right to modify a roach.
rules.decision: Use home facilities, a club bay or a paid fitting service.
rules.observable: Casual access and expert ownership coexist.

rules.statement: A test loan changes custody of a particular component for an agreed session.
rules.decision: Try a motor-equivalent before buying.
rules.observable: One component cannot be on the shop display and two test racers simultaneously.

rules.statement: A comparison ticket identifies fixed conditions, changed components and intended measurements.
rules.decision: Compare a drive replacement or a preload change.
rules.observable: An observed result is attributable to a stated experiment, not a universal best-build score.

rules.statement: Guided kit assembly shows the actual parts, placement and incorporation; advanced adjustment remains on the same objects.
rules.decision: Assemble the tin or modify its recipe.
rules.observable: The beginner still builds their own racer.

rules.statement: A failed fitting previews blocked motion, inadequate support or an event conflict separately.
rules.decision: Move the graft, alter support or select an eligible event.
rules.observable: No universal one-brow-slot rule returns.

rules.statement: A fitting commission states desired outcome, supplied stock, labor, testing and revision terms.
rules.decision: Earn money through assembly expertise.
rules.observable: Professional work can improve execution without secretly improving donor genetics.

rules.statement: A loan return or service completion records actual condition; new loss rules cannot be introduced retroactively.
rules.decision: Accept known terms before handing over valued stock.
rules.observable: Service income does not depend on surprise confiscation or mandatory permadeath.

systems.title: Modular courses that support a modular hobby

rules.statement: A section defines inlet and outlet pose, width, surface, usable paths, supports and active clearance.
rules.decision: Assemble valid connected pieces.
rules.observable: A track is both geometry and ordered travel, not a bag of section names.

rules.statement: An installed course uses owned or borrowed section instances and a separate layout recipe.
rules.decision: Pool, hire, buy or rearrange track pieces.
rules.observable: A plan does not spawn the physical course.

rules.statement: Passing space is authored as track geometry; guided and shared sections are both valid formats.
rules.decision: Build a technical channel or a broad pack circuit.
rules.observable: Contact opportunities follow the actual layout.

rules.statement: Alternative routes declare their entry, exit, required gates and locomotion conditions.
rules.decision: Choose a legitimate jump or climbing route.
rules.observable: Route freedom does not silently skip mandatory course progress.

rules.statement: Inside and outside paths have different physical distances when geometry makes them different.
rules.decision: Take an inside line or a clear outside pass.
rules.observable: Lateral position affects both distance and maneuvering; no artificial equal-distance assumption.

rules.statement: A repeated qualifying format can rotate start assignments; a single experimental grid is not proof of competitive fairness.
rules.decision: Choose published heat and seeding procedures.
rules.observable: Grid advantage is assessed instead of hidden.

rules.statement: Surface wear and cleaning change declared contact conditions only when that system is present.
rules.decision: Maintain a venue or prepare suitable feet.
rules.observable: The course does not receive arbitrary invisible difficulty multipliers.

rules.statement: A layout revision creates a new record category while retaining historic times under their original layout.
rules.decision: Modify a famous circuit and set new records.
rules.observable: An old champion is not retroactively disqualified by a later rebuild.

systems.title: Pace, passing, contact and the finish

rules.statement: Running output uses loaded drive, energy delivery, traction, body mass and leverage.
rules.decision: Improve the desired mechanical contribution.
rules.observable: Pace emerges from motion integration rather than a hidden race-power score.

rules.statement: A passing maneuver identifies available space, commits to a side and recenters after clearance.
rules.decision: Attempt a pass rather than repeatedly steering toward and away from the same rival.
rules.observable: The racer follows through on an observable overtaking attempt.

rules.statement: Hopper loading and locomotion share current reserve and delivery; released energy is not spent twice.
rules.decision: Choose preload and timing.
rules.observable: An active maneuver has a real resource cost before its benefit.

rules.statement: A jump uses inherited tissue and setup to determine useful energy, trajectory and recovery.
rules.decision: Change the donor, preload, alignment or route.
rules.observable: A better spring is not a guaranteed pass at every speed or clearance.

rules.statement: A horn attack requires reachable aligned contact after wind-up; a miss consumes the declared commitment.
rules.decision: Build and use a useful ram geometry.
rules.observable: No remote damage is awarded from an attack rating.

rules.statement: A grasping response has closure delay, reach, hold and recovery; holding can impede both racers.
rules.decision: Intercept a committed rival or release to resume racing.
rules.observable: Claws create a racing decision rather than a permanent disable.

rules.statement: Native contact and dedicated weapons are different capabilities; Speedsters permits the former and excludes the latter.
rules.decision: Select the intended division.
rules.observable: Weapon legality is not decided by cosmetic naming.

rules.statement: Recovery states preserve course location and elapsed time.
rules.decision: Regain motion through existing anatomy or supported intervention.
rules.observable: Falling behind is a racing consequence; the game does not silently reset position.

rules.statement: Finish classification requires the full ordered course; ties and nonfinishers have declared handling.
rules.decision: Complete the race.
rules.observable: Neither damage count nor a bench result grants victory.

rules.statement: The simulation reads inherited internal properties; public advice and commercial claims read only acquired evidence.
rules.decision: Observe, test and disclose selectively.
rules.observable: Mechanical correctness does not create an omniscient shopping interface.

systems.title: The event is a funded operation

rules.statement: A meeting names venue, layout, locomotion, equipment policy, format, entry conditions and qualification consequences independently.
rules.decision: Enter an appropriate local race or qualifier.
rules.observable: Open is build freedom; local participation is not automatic World City admission.

rules.statement: A practice run can award a local record or rival acknowledgement without creating a cash prize.
rules.decision: Practice freely or enter a funded event.
rules.observable: Replay and practice do not print tournament money.

rules.statement: Prize commitments name entry receipts, sponsor funds, club funds or other declared backing.
rules.decision: Host an event at a sustainable size.
rules.observable: Prize money is transferred once from an identifiable budget.

rules.statement: Tied placements share the affected prize allocation under published terms.
rules.decision: Resolve a dead heat.
rules.observable: An identifier or iteration order does not select the richer winner.

rules.statement: Operational payments fund actual hosting activities separately from race prizes.
rules.decision: Provide timing, track setup, staffing or facility services.
rules.observable: Trackmakers and hosts can earn a keep without winning races.

rules.statement: A sanctioned result stores the named host, build snapshot, finish and course.
rules.decision: Keep a trophy, publish a record or enter the next qualifier.
rules.observable: A racer retains a career across equipment changes.

rules.statement: Replays, photographs and subsequent comparisons reference the original result without recommitting its transactions.
rules.decision: Revisit a race or share its build.
rules.observable: Watching a win twice does not pay twice.

rules.statement: A race winner is not automatically a genetically certified breeding line.
rules.decision: Celebrate the win and offer an appropriately qualified claim.
rules.observable: Prestige can generate attention without fabricating inherited guarantees.

systems.title: Race attention becomes specific hobby demand

rules.statement: A viewer notices a visible performance or appearance; an inquiry precedes a purchase unless a standing agreement already exists.
rules.decision: Demonstrate, advertise or decline to disclose.
rules.observable: Publicity is an opportunity, not instant sale revenue.

rules.statement: A trial order states the useful component, observable acceptance criteria and funded quantity.
rules.decision: Sell a small credible batch before promising a major run.
rules.observable: The buyer purchases a specified assembly, not a promise that every child wins.

rules.statement: A buyer pays for performance, fit, consistency, availability, appearance or provenance according to its purpose.
rules.decision: Choose the appropriate market for retained and surplus stock.
rules.observable: Different customers can value the same cohort differently.

rules.statement: Funded inquiries compete for actual supply and production capacity; growing young remain future inventory.
rules.decision: Allocate stock among personal builds, founders, ordinary sales and commissions.
rules.observable: Commercial success creates meaningful allocation choices.

rules.statement: Consignment retains the consignor identity until a real sale; fees and custody are explicit.
rules.decision: Use a shop to reach customers without selling outright.
rules.observable: Shelf price and shop possession do not become realized seller income.

rules.statement: Recurring demand depends on customer activity and budgets outside the breeding tank.
rules.decision: Serve kit buyers, collectors, racers, clubs and traders.
rules.observable: No rule assumes that fresh animals are needed only because every race destroys them.

rules.statement: Ordinary paid services and common-stock buyers remain accessible recovery routes.
rules.decision: Earn modest income after a failed ambitious project.
rules.observable: A major race loss need not force a second career or wipe the workshop.

rules.statement: A broader economy may aggregate ordinary household spending, but its replenishment must be declared and bounded.
rules.decision: Scale the world without simulating every citizen at full fidelity.
rules.observable: Aggregate customers still have accountable expenditure rather than infinite wallets.

systems.title: Performance questions lead back into the wildlands

rules.statement: Race symptoms identify candidate explanations, not unique hidden genetic diagnoses.
rules.decision: Check fuel, condition, setup and comparable assays before replacing a lineage.
rules.observable: Late fading does not automatically mean poor inherited endurance.

rules.statement: A targeted run links the missing contribution to a donor, stage, habitat and inspectable sign.
rules.decision: Pursue loaded cadence, release timing, wing integrity or a particular appearance.
rules.observable: The trip has a stated use without guaranteed rarity.

rules.statement: A currently useful founder can be an ordinary performer that supplies the missing inherited complement.
rules.decision: Retain synchronized hoppers for a high-return line.
rules.observable: Field selection uses the current project, not only the finished-product cutoff.

rules.statement: The same route can supply several disjoint customer needs and personal interests.
rules.decision: Return with common pads, selected arms or attractive moths.
rules.observable: Unwanted for one racer does not mean worthless to every customer.

rules.statement: Published demand changes which traits a catcher seeks, not which genes already captured animals possess.
rules.decision: Revisit known habitats for previously ignored characteristics.
rules.observable: A new race trend cannot reroll existing specimens.

rules.statement: Population recovery, stage changes and travel use world time; entering a screen is not a new cohort.
rules.decision: Choose another route, breed, trade or wait under the declared clock.
rules.observable: Rare searching remains an activity rather than a reload exploit.

systems.title: Breeding, stage timing and race-season commitments

rules.statement: A seasonal supply plan schedules brood, target stage, preparation, transport and receipt against an event or customer date.
rules.decision: Choose which project can mature in time.
rules.observable: A useful specimen arriving after the final is a different commercial proposition.

rules.statement: Ordinary intermediary output and retained replacements can support a premium project simultaneously.
rules.decision: Sell useful stock while continuing selective work.
rules.observable: Selection need not wait for a perfect genotype before earning anything.

rules.statement: Stage-specific products use an actual developmental window, not a generic adult rarity upgrade.
rules.decision: Produce Clockleaf couplings at the useful stage while retaining reproductive adults.
rules.observable: An adult-only enclosure cannot supply every stage on demand.

rules.statement: Preparation and storage windows remain product-specific; frozen future output cannot be sold as ready stock.
rules.decision: Prepare near delivery or pay for supported preservation.
rules.observable: Storage services change scheduling, not inherited quality.

rules.statement: A line claim includes tested offspring, brood identities, protocol and date.
rules.decision: Sell reliability backed by observed batches.
rules.observable: One famous installed pair does not certify every descendant.

rules.statement: Race attendance advances the same broader world obligations when the clocks are integrated.
rules.decision: Arrange care before a circuit trip.
rules.observable: The later runtime must advance production and upkeep together; the present race witness does not yet do so.

systems.title: Clubs, Wrangloids and rivals share the same world

rules.statement: Wrangloids combine finding, breeding, trading and expertise in different proportions; their profession is not an exclusive permission.
rules.decision: Become a supplier, customer, breeder or some combination.
rules.observable: Every person can attempt the underlying hobby activities.

rules.statement: An NPC racer has owned stock, available money, knowledge, preferred activities and an event schedule.
rules.decision: Compete, trade, lend, teach or commission work.
rules.observable: A rival does not conjure a perfect counterbuild from private player data.

rules.statement: NPC changes follow their observations and available opportunities, including shop stock and public build cards.
rules.decision: Demonstrate an idea or keep parts undisclosed.
rules.observable: The competitive scene can adapt without omniscience.

rules.statement: Club participation can provide shared tools, borrowed sections, introductions and practice partners.
rules.decision: Join for material and social benefits rather than a hidden stat aura.
rules.observable: A club matters even to a collector who does not campaign for the Derby.

rules.statement: Faction support differs through facilities, funded programs, supply contacts and representative selection.
rules.decision: Choose affiliations and opportunities.
rules.observable: Faction identity is not reduced to a palette swap or a universally superior gene.

rules.statement: Collectors, finishers, kit authors and track builders receive distinct credit.
rules.decision: Show a beautiful animal, sell a signature tin or host a remarkable layout.
rules.observable: Recognition is not exclusively awarded to the current fastest racer.

rules.statement: Advice, sale reputation, competition standing and lineage evidence are independent records.
rules.decision: Trust a reliable seller without assuming they are the best racer.
rules.observable: One popularity scalar does not replace every relationship.

systems.title: Visible changes, useful records and optional depth

rules.statement: Primary race presentation shows position, direction, major actions, remaining distance and the finish.
rules.decision: Watch the race as a sporting event.
rules.observable: Diagnostic detail does not displace excitement and readable competition.

rules.statement: A visible module signature accompanies its action: horn commitment, folding grasp, loaded hind limbs and landing compression.
rules.decision: Recognize the graft personally fitted.
rules.observable: The roach is not rendered as an identical marker with different stat text.

rules.statement: A result card shows placing and time first, followed by the actual build and optional component evidence.
rules.decision: Celebrate, compare or publish.
rules.observable: The victory is not reframed as merely solving a track.

rules.statement: Public build cards can disclose component identity without revealing hidden genes or unmeasured values.
rules.decision: Show off or keep a preparation detail private.
rules.observable: A photograph is not an omniscient assay.

rules.statement: A replay inspector links each major action to the fitted component and relevant preparation.
rules.decision: Inspect a pass or failed jump after watching it.
rules.observable: The evidence remains attached to the same asset rather than an unrelated tutorial page.

rules.statement: Replay controls do not mutate the underlying outcome, inventory, world clock or purse.
rules.decision: Scrub, pause and switch experiments.
rules.observable: Presentation does not rerun a payable event.

rules.statement: The delivered browser surface is an experimental replay viewer, not the editable kit bench or finished game.
rules.decision: Review the visible mechanism at its actual scope.
rules.observable: Unimplemented assembly and simulation controls are not represented by dead buttons.

operational_threads.trigger: A build consistently accelerates more slowly under a matched load.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare fuel delivery, mass and leverage before interpreting the drive assay.
operational_threads.selection: Loaded cadence and usable force, not loudness.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine useful cadence with efficient output; retain productive founders.
operational_threads.customer: Club racers and coordinated kit authors.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Component upgrade demand supports adult stock sales and complete nursery investments.

operational_threads.name: A hopper line worth repeating
operational_threads.origin: PCR landing control plus RRR active jumping
operational_threads.trigger: A clean overtake succeeds, or landing recovery loses the gained position.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Separate launch preload, alignment and inherited phase/settling measurements.
operational_threads.selection: The missing synchronization or settling contribution, including ordinary-return candidates.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Build a joint return/synchrony/settling target across generations.

operational_threads.customer: Ordinary kit shop plus selected-component customers.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Intermediary stock funds continued selection while actual installed examples advertise the line.

operational_threads.name: Grip that releases in time
operational_threads.trigger: Foot-slip or slow foot release appears in controlled running.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare the same surface, moisture, load and current cleanliness.
operational_threads.selection: Purchase plus fast peel release; keep attractive forms independently.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine complementary pad properties and select consistent usable pairs.
operational_threads.output: Sticktoe foot sets or alternative brake strips.
operational_threads.customer: Technical racers, brake makers and collectors.
operational_threads.world_consequence: A single route supports different buyers; no duplicate harvest of the same pads.
operational_threads.limit: Full foot gait is not in the current race solver.

operational_threads.name: The base transfers the charge
operational_threads.origin: RRR derby weapon, integrated with PCR frame support
operational_threads.trigger: A ram contacts but deflects or destabilizes its own support.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Inspect contact direction, root structure and support before blaming size.
operational_threads.where: Debris-covered compost margins on the Cooling-kiln route.
operational_threads.selection: Root strength and useful curvature rather than longest tip.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine a useful horn geometry with strong, consistent roots.
operational_threads.output: Bullhorn Ram and disjoint support products.

operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare actual reach, closure response and target alignment.

operational_threads.breeding_objective: Outcross reach and closure contributions without relying on body size.
operational_threads.customer: Open and Fireworks racers; legal brace buyers.

operational_threads.limit: Current claw operator is a contact-delay proxy, not articulated limb physics.

operational_threads.trigger: A repeat order requests matched couplings before a meeting.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Verify stage, current function and delivery window rather than buying the largest adults.

operational_threads.selection: Precision plus a practical usable-stage window.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Retain adult founders and schedule juvenile output separately.

operational_threads.origin: RRR Flyers with PCR power/handling functions
operational_threads.trigger: Flyer clients request efficient matched wing-root assemblies.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Distinguish damage, fit, drive supply and repeatable root response.

operational_threads.selection: Wing efficiency, root endurance and intact expansion.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Track parents through aquatic young and emergence rather than adult-only cages.

operational_threads.next_evidence: Record appearance, provenance and condition; do not invent superior race traits.
operational_threads.where: Sheltered textile ruins and nearby vegetation.
operational_threads.selection: The requested markings or structure, not a generic rarity color.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Select the appearance goal while preserving viable reproduction.
operational_threads.output: Whole display stock, prepared vanes or signature presentation kit.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Aesthetics produces collection value and optional livelihoods alongside racing.
operational_threads.limit: No formula for player aesthetic preference is claimed.

systems.title: Draft, fitted host and physical custody

rules.statement: A draft changes a proposed arrangement, not the host or current component custody.
rules.decision: Try a new build before committing.
rules.consequence: The currently fitted racer remains available and unchanged.

rules.statement: A fitting commit validates the whole draft, then swaps the intended components together.
rules.decision: Fit an accepted layout.
rules.consequence: A failure does not remove half a build or install a duplicate.

rules.statement: The same prepared sect identity may be loose, packaged or installed in the broader system, but never in two places at once.
rules.decision: Choose its present use.
rules.consequence: A saved recipe is not an additional component.

rules.statement: Repeated fitting of an unchanged arrangement is a no-op.
rules.decision: Confirm or retry safely.
rules.consequence: No second revision, duplicate anatomy or charge is created.

rules.statement: Replacement native units are explicitly retained in the W05 bench cradle.
rules.decision: Return an installed replacement.
rules.consequence: The retained native unit is reinstalled; tissue is not regenerated.

rules.statement: This reusable preparation profile applies only to the declared bench experiment.
rules.decision: Select the branch explicitly.
rules.consequence: W04 removal, injury and preservation decisions remain open elsewhere.

rules.statement: Returning a component in the draft does not yet make the fitted item loose.
rules.decision: Review removals before commitment.
rules.consequence: Draft and installed readouts use different labels.

rules.statement: A whole multi-role Hopper assembly contributes mass and inventory once.
rules.decision: Use the paired unit rather than duplicated role slots.
rules.consequence: Jump and landing capabilities do not create extra limbs.

rules.statement: A host retains its nameable identity across fitted versions.
rules.decision: Rebuild the same racer.
rules.consequence: A new configuration is not a newly bred animal.

rules.statement: Any future payment or care commitment must attach to the actual fitting transaction.
rules.decision: Extend the fixture into the operating world.
rules.consequence: Free session editing is not claimed as calibrated workshop economics.

systems.title: Meaningful placement and bounded physical fitting

rules.statement: Prepared-root ranges describe the supported geometry of the current components, not a universal species permission.
rules.decision: Move a root within its usable preparation.
rules.consequence: Unsupported fit identifies the component and needed correction.

rules.statement: Root collision is checked using oriented rectangles on named attachment layers.
rules.decision: Rotate or reposition a conflicting component.
rules.consequence: Intersecting same-layer roots block commitment; different layers can coexist.

rules.statement: The prepared starter host has one primary-drive interface in this fixture.
rules.decision: Choose Redline, Torque or retained native drive.
rules.consequence: The local interface limitation does not ban multi-drive roaches from RRR.

rules.statement: A central horn and split brow vanes can coexist if their actual roots do not intersect.
rules.decision: Compose rather than obey an arbitrary brow-slot ban.
rules.consequence: The accepted arrangement is visible and can enter Open.

rules.statement: Hopper rotation and off-center fitting contribute mounting error separately from inherited phase.
rules.decision: Align the prepared pair.
rules.consequence: Remounting can change useful launch transfer without rewriting ancestry.

rules.statement: Horn forward position and yaw change projected reach; lateral offset changes its modeled contact line.
rules.decision: Adjust the contact geometry.
rules.consequence: The displayed fit has a named mechanical consequence.

rules.statement: Claw placement changes modeled reach and angle can change closure delay.
rules.decision: Set the intended interception envelope.
rules.consequence: No passive armor or remote control effect is added.

rules.statement: Not every permitted cosmetic or spatial adjustment must improve lap time.
rules.decision: Fit for clearance, appearance or performance as appropriate.
rules.consequence: The UI does not manufacture a bonus for every drag.

systems.title: Inherited traits, setup and source function

rules.statement: Drive cadence and useful force remain separate from hip leverage.
rules.decision: Select a drive then tune its delivery.
rules.consequence: A gear-equivalent does not create a second motor.

rules.statement: Preload spends the available launch supply and is bounded by the local assembly profile.
rules.decision: Select an active-jump setup.
rules.consequence: A dormant or absent Hopper does not confer an unexplained speed multiplier.

rules.statement: Reserve fill changes starting energy and entry mass; storage capacity and delivery remain component properties.
rules.decision: Prepare a short run or a longer run.
rules.consequence: Feeding does not mutate inherited reserve quality.

rules.statement: Running stance changes the modeled body envelope and passing clearance.
rules.decision: Choose a wider or narrower configuration.
rules.consequence: Visual stance and collision width come from the same setting.

rules.statement: The current pad model changes traction; full peel-release gait is not claimed.
rules.decision: Compare the defined contact contribution.
rules.consequence: Untested foot dynamics remain explicit missing fidelity.

rules.statement: The split-vane fixture adds a speed-dependent hold-down term rather than powered flight.
rules.decision: Fit aero to a ground racer.
rules.consequence: It can affect traction and corner control without granting Flyer eligibility.

rules.statement: Livery, name and number have no mechanical multiplier.
rules.decision: Make the racer recognizable.
rules.consequence: Appearance and collection value do not require fabricated race superiority.

rules.statement: Available measurements in this stock profile are declared fixture observations.
rules.decision: Inspect the known stock.
rules.consequence: No full genotype oracle or unperformed assay is presented as earned knowledge.

systems.title: Actual entry, frozen records and comparisons

rules.statement: Race entry requires a committed design; an unresolved draft is neither silently discarded nor silently installed.
rules.decision: Commit or revert deliberately.
rules.consequence: The entered build is unambiguous.

rules.statement: A race is newly computed from its entry snapshot rather than chosen from a result table.
rules.decision: Test a new assembly or setting.
rules.consequence: Changed parts can cause changed motion and finish times.

rules.statement: Class checks inspect actual offensive capability, not the selected approach or product label.
rules.decision: Enter Speedsters, Fireworks or Open.
rules.consequence: A peaceful policy does not legalize a fitted weapon in Speedsters.

rules.statement: Current editable events are ground-only.
rules.decision: Use supported practice settings.
rules.consequence: Full sustained-flight simulation remains open rather than approximated by a ground race.

rules.statement: Rivals use independently identified declared stock and published fixture behavior.
rules.decision: Choose a useful practice opponent.
rules.consequence: The rival does not read hidden player genetics to manufacture a counterbuild.

rules.statement: Frozen results preserve the build, positions, appearance, settings, course and policy used at entry.
rules.decision: Watch, export or inspect an old run.
rules.consequence: Later bench edits do not alter a previous finish.

rules.statement: A matched comparison requires the same course, laps, class, rival and starting grid.
rules.decision: Pin a useful reference.
rules.consequence: A changed course is flagged rather than attributed solely to the component.

rules.statement: Practice, replay and exported result records do not mint prize money or advance the world clock in this slice.
rules.decision: Experiment without fictional payouts.
rules.consequence: The separate coupled-clock and funded-event tasks remain open.

rules.decision: Inspect the loss or revise the build.
rules.consequence: First valid finish remains the racing objective.

rules.consequence: Import cannot create a donor, genome, wallet or trophy.

rules.consequence: Usable consistency does not require genetic clones.

rules.statement: Personal instance sheets and commercial product specifications remain distinct document types.
rules.decision: Reproduce a personal build or produce a repeatable product.
rules.consequence: The current exact-stock importer is not advertised as a general market solver.

rules.statement: A commercial bill of materials identifies retained native anatomy and all transferred components.

rules.consequence: Several functional roles cannot conceal missing or duplicated tissue.

rules.statement: Breeders select for the traits a component or customer needs; fitters control preparation and arrangement.
rules.decision: Breed, buy, commission or personally build.
rules.consequence: A fitting improvement does not falsely certify improved inheritance.

rules.statement: A component can be strong but awkward to fit to a particular host.
rules.decision: Reserve it for a custom commission, adjust the preparation or choose another buyer.
rules.consequence: Poor fit for one kit is not universal low quality.

rules.consequence: The statistical/genetic model is an expansion task, not invented by this fixed catalogue.

rules.decision: Earn through building expertise.
rules.consequence: Compensation is attached to performed work rather than a promise of winning every race.

rules.statement: An inspection or bench trial can support a narrow claim about configuration.
rules.decision: Sell measurable adjustment work.
rules.consequence: One result does not imply an entire donor line is genetically certified.

rules.statement: Routine compatible stock, useful intermediates and unusual custom stock can serve different funded customers.
rules.decision: Allocate a cohort among production, selection, personal builds and sales.
rules.consequence: Progress does not wait for a perfect organism.

rules.statement: The editable prototype grants no new market funds, breeding output or service income.

rules.consequence: Economy behavior remains attached to the queued shared inventory and clock implementation.

rules.decision: Recognize a selected sect before opening numbers.
rules.consequence: Different donors are not anonymous stat cards.

rules.consequence: Precise pointer skill is not required to assemble the kit.

rules.decision: Fit, move or recolor a part.
rules.consequence: The bench, saved sheet and recorded racer remain visibly connected.

rules.decision: Inspect the fitted drive or reserve.
rules.consequence: A view toggle does not change performance.

rules.consequence: Optional controls do not generate a large empty canvas or hide the commit bar.

rules.consequence: Rendering cannot detach and cancel the source action.

rules.consequence: Information is not available solely through tiny moving markers.

rules.decision: Choose when to watch movement.
rules.consequence: The whole simulation remains available without forced autoplay.

rules.statement: Focus, labels, fit warnings and textual state supplement color.

MIVIM.novel_objective: The same personally assembled insects and owned course pieces determine contact behavior, donor selection, product preparation and useful hosting work.
MIVIM.comparator: Preset circuits and generic handling buffs disconnected from anatomy, stock ownership or course contact.
MIVIM.quality: Implemented model and reviewed local interaction; complete game/human acceptance remain open.
MIVIM.novel_development_adherence: Concrete project-specific source-function, biological material, assembly and owned-course integration; no worldwide novelty claim.
MIVIM.effectiveness: Supported by actual browser and bounded model outcomes; not a proof of engagement.
MIVIM.creativity: Distinctive linked construction/material interpretation delivered; experiential originality unmeasured.
MIVIM.scaling_potential: Reusable profiles and explicit geometry identities permit extension; sampled pair checks and local archive bounds are not large-world benchmarks.

limits: One local world and two-racer path-space ground races; no rigid-body limb physics, free aerial paths or lane-changing bridges.
Track editor is a snapped ordered chain of fixed dimensions and a conservative sampled planar-overlap check; not arbitrary free placement or a full terrain editor.

Passive Brake Rise uses a fixed normalized angle and height with simplified approach dynamics. An airborne arrival at a bend retires; no global death, destructive damage or retrieval simulation added.
Raised approach source is the physical Mini 4WD hobby layer, not an alleged additional Gaiden menu slot. No source-game numerical formula is invented.
Two new donor forms retain the limited three-independent-locus profile. No mutation, linkage, colony genetics, appearance heredity or full material science.
Rail contact is a limited-load planar friction proxy. Native corner response remains. Guide friction has no effect away from contact; passive shell stabilizers do not supply powered steering.
Prepared parts remain stable stock under the restricted reusable native-cradle model. Transport viability, broad graft removal and stage-preservation systems remain open.

One finite layout service, two finite new selected orders and one conversion set. Player-manufactured complete-kit selling, evidence-backed breeder commission acceptance and autonomous demand renewal are not delivered.
Fixed section prices, care, genotype coefficients and track dimensions are experimental. A tested profitable transaction or finish is not economic or retention calibration.

Local editable saves are consistency checked, not anti-cheat. File navigation blocked in test host; exact HTML set_content used. Native Windows/macOS storage, physical touch and human testing unverified.
